```{r Libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(car)
library(pROC)
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(corrplot)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r Data Import and Prep}
adult <- read.csv(file = "/Users/Owner/git/School/DS6372_Applied_Statistics/Project2/Data/adult.csv")

adult_test <- read.csv(file = "/Users/Owner/git/School/DS6372_Applied_Statistics/Project2/Data/adult_test.csv")

# Convert '?' and '' to NA
adult[] <- lapply(adult, function(x) { x[x == "" | x == "?"] <- NA; x })
adult_test[] <- lapply(adult_test, function(x) { x[x == "" | x == "?"] <- NA; x })

adult <- na.omit(adult)
adult_test <- na.omit(adult_test)

# Factor conversion
categorical_vars <- c("workclass", "education", "Marital.status", "occupation", "relationship", "race", "sex", "Native.country", "income")
adult[categorical_vars] <- lapply(adult[categorical_vars], factor)
adult_test[categorical_vars] <- lapply(adult_test[categorical_vars], factor)
```

```{r Data Structure and Summary}
str(adult)
summary(adult)
colSums(is.na(adult))
sum(duplicated(adult))
```

```{r EDA}
# Numeric Distributions
numeric_vars <- sapply(adult, is.numeric)
num_df <- adult[, numeric_vars]

ggplot(adult, aes(age, fill=income)) + geom_histogram(bins=30, alpha=0.7, position="identity") + labs(title="Age by Income")

ggplot(adult, aes(Education.num, fill=income)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1, alpha=0.7) + labs(title="Education Number by Income")

ggplot(adult, aes(Hours.per.week, fill=income)) + geom_histogram(bins=30, alpha=0.7) + labs(title="Hours per Week by Income")

ggplot(adult, aes(Capital.gain, fill=income)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=5000, alpha=0.7) + labs(title="Capital Gain by Income")

ggplot(adult, aes(log1p(Capital.gain), fill=income)) + geom_histogram(bins=30, alpha=0.7) + labs(title="Log-Capital Gain by Income")

ggplot(adult, aes(Capital.loss, fill=income)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=500, alpha=0.7) + labs(title="Capital Loss by Income")

ggplot(adult, aes(log1p(Capital.loss), fill=income)) + geom_histogram(bins=30, alpha=0.7) + labs(title="Log-Capital Loss by Income")

boxplot(num_df, main="Numeric Variables: Boxplots", outline=TRUE, col="skyblue", las=2)

ggplot(adult, aes(sex, fill=income)) + geom_bar(position="stack") + labs(title="Income by Sex")

ggplot(adult, aes(x = relationship, fill = income)) +
```

```{r Baseline Logistic Regression Model}
logit_model <- glm(income ~ age + workclass + fnlwgt + education + Education.num + Marital.status +
                     occupation + relationship + race + sex + Capital.gain + Capital.loss +
                     Hours.per.week + Native.country,
                   data = adult, family = "binomial")
summary(logit_model)

logit_model_noednum <- glm(income ~ age + workclass + fnlwgt + education + Marital.status +
                   occupation + relationship + race + sex + Capital.gain + Capital.loss +
                   Hours.per.week + Native.country,
                   data = adult, family = "binomial")
summary(logit_model_noednum)
```

```{r Multicollinearity}
vif_values <- vif(logit_model_noednum)
print(vif_values)
```

```{r Feature Selection}
step_model <- step(logit_model_noednum, direction = "both")
summary(step_model)
```

```{r Coefficients}
odds_ratios <- exp(coef(step_model))
percent_change <- (odds_ratios - 1) * 100
coef_table <- data.frame(OddsRatio = odds_ratios, PercentChange = percent_change)
print(coef_table)
```

```{r Diagnostics}
plot(step_model)
```

```{r Prediction}
# Get all factor columns
factor_cols <- names(adult)[sapply(adult, is.factor)]

# Match levels for all categorical variables in test set to training set
for (col in factor_cols) {
  levels(adult_test[[col]]) <- levels(adult[[col]])
}


test_probs <- predict(step_model, newdata = adult_test, type = "response")
test_preds <- ifelse(test_probs > 0.5, ">50K", "<=50K")
```

```{r Confusion Matrix & Performance}
confusionMatrix(factor(test_preds), factor(adult_test$income))
```

```{r ROC & AUC}
library(pROC)
roc_obj <- roc(adult_test$income, test_probs)
plot(roc_obj, main="ROC Curve")
auc(roc_obj)
```

```{r Optimizing Threshold}
best <- coords(roc_obj, "best", ret="threshold")
optimal_threshold <- 0.1593779
opt_preds <- ifelse(test_probs > optimal_threshold, ">50K", "<=50K")

confusionMatrix(factor(opt_preds), factor(adult_test$income))
```

```{r Complex Model}
logit_model_complex <- glm(income ~ age * education + poly(age, 2) +
                            workclass + Marital.status + occupation +
                            relationship + race + sex + Capital.gain +
                            Capital.loss + Hours.per.week + Native.country,
                          data = adult, family = "binomial")
summary(logit_model_complex)

complex_probs <- predict(logit_model_complex, newdata = adult_test, type = "response")

roc_complex <- roc(adult_test$income, complex_probs)
plot(roc_complex)
auc(roc_complex)
complex_threshold <- coords(roc_complex, "best", ret = "threshold")
complex_threshold <- as.numeric(complex_threshold)
complex_preds <- ifelse(complex_probs > complex_threshold, ">50K", "<=50K")
cm_complex <- confusionMatrix(factor(complex_preds), factor(adult_test$income))

complex_sens <- cm_complex$byClass["Sensitivity"]
complex_spec <- cm_complex$byClass["Specificity"]
complex_ppv  <- cm_complex$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
complex_npv  <- cm_complex$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
complex_acc  <- cm_complex$overall["Accuracy"]
```

```{r LDA model}
lda_model <- lda(income ~ age + education + workclass + sex + Capital.gain +
                 Capital.loss + Hours.per.week + Native.country,
                 data = adult)
lda_probs <- predict(lda_model, newdata = adult_test)$posterior[,2]
roc_lda <- roc(adult_test$income, lda_probs)
auc(roc_lda)

lda_threshold <- coords(roc_lda, "best", ret = "threshold")
lda_threshold <- as.numeric(lda_threshold)
lda_pred_class <- ifelse(lda_probs > lda_threshold, ">50K", "<=50K")
cm_lda <- confusionMatrix(factor(lda_pred_class), factor(adult_test$income))

lda_sens <- cm_lda$byClass["Sensitivity"]
lda_spec <- cm_lda$byClass["Specificity"]
lda_ppv <- cm_lda$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
lda_npv <- cm_lda$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
lda_acc <- cm_lda$overall["Accuracy"]

```

```{r QDA Model}
# Select predictors with high data completeness and low collinearity
qda_vars <- c("age", "Hours.per.week")

# Ensure only complete cases (no missing values) are used
adult_qda <- adult[complete.cases(adult[, qda_vars]), ]
adult_test_qda <- adult_test[complete.cases(adult_test[, qda_vars]), ]

# Fit QDA model on training data
qda_model <- qda(income ~ age + Hours.per.week, data = adult_qda)

# Predict posterior probabilities on test set
qda_pred <- predict(qda_model, newdata = adult_test_qda)
qda_probs <- qda_pred$posterior[,2]  # Probability for ">50K"

# Compute ROC curve and AUC
roc_qda <- roc(adult_test_qda$income, qda_probs)
plot(roc_qda, main = "QDA ROC Curve")
auc(roc_qda)

# Find optimal threshold using ROC analysis
qda_threshold <- coords(roc_qda, "best", ret = "threshold")
qda_threshold <- as.numeric(qda_threshold)

# Classify predictions using optimal threshold
qda_pred_class <- ifelse(qda_probs > qda_threshold, ">50K", "<=50K")

# Build results data frame and filter out NA
results_df <- data.frame(pred = qda_pred_class, actual = adult_test_qda$income)
results_df <- results_df[!is.na(results_df$pred) & !is.na(results_df$actual), ]
income_levels <- c("<=50K", ">50K")
results_df$pred <- factor(results_df$pred, levels = income_levels)
results_df$actual <- factor(results_df$actual, levels = income_levels)

# Confusion matrix and performance metrics
confusionMatrix(results_df$pred, results_df$actual)

# Optional: show prediction distribution for sanity check
table(results_df$pred)
table(results_df$actual)

cm_qda <- confusionMatrix(results_df$pred, results_df$actual)

qda_sens <- cm_qda$byClass["Sensitivity"]
qda_spec <- cm_qda$byClass["Specificity"]
qda_ppv <- cm_qda$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
qda_npv <- cm_qda$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
qda_acc <- cm_qda$overall["Accuracy"]

```

```{r Decision Tree}
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot) # For nice tree plots

# Select top predictors for interpretability and minimal collinearity
tree_vars <- c("age", "workclass", "education", "Marital.status", 
               "occupation", "relationship", "race", "sex", 
               "Capital.gain", "Capital.loss", "Hours.per.week", "Native.country")

# Use only complete cases for chosen predictors in both train and test
adult_tree <- adult[complete.cases(adult[, tree_vars]), ]
adult_test_tree <- adult_test[complete.cases(adult_test[, tree_vars]), ]

# Ensure factor levels in test match those in train for all categorical variables
factor_vars <- c("workclass", "education", "Marital.status", "occupation",
                 "relationship", "race", "sex", "Native.country")
for (col in factor_vars) {
  levels(adult_test_tree[[col]]) <- levels(adult_tree[[col]])
}

# Fit the decision tree
tree_model <- rpart(income ~ ., data = adult_tree[, c(tree_vars, "income")], method = "class",
                    control = rpart.control(cp = 0.01, xval = 10))

# Plot the tree for interpretability
rpart.plot(tree_model, extra = 104, under = TRUE, type = 2, faclen = 0, cex = 0.6)

# Predict class probabilities (for >50K) in test set
tree_pred_probs <- predict(tree_model, newdata = adult_test_tree, type = "prob")[,2]

# ROC and AUC
roc_tree <- roc(adult_test_tree$income, tree_pred_probs)
plot(roc_tree, main = "ROC Curve: Decision Tree")
auc(roc_tree)

# Optimal threshold from ROC
tree_threshold <- coords(roc_tree, "best", ret = "threshold")
tree_threshold <- as.numeric(tree_threshold)

# Predict classes using optimal threshold
tree_pred_class <- ifelse(tree_pred_probs > tree_threshold, ">50K", "<=50K")

# Build results data frame and remove incomplete predictions
tree_df <- data.frame(pred = tree_pred_class, actual = adult_test_tree$income)
tree_df <- tree_df[!is.na(tree_df$pred) & !is.na(tree_df$actual), ]

# Ensure proper factor levels
income_levels <- c("<=50K", ">50K")
tree_df$pred <- factor(tree_df$pred, levels = income_levels)
tree_df$actual <- factor(tree_df$actual, levels = income_levels)

# Confusion matrix and model performance metrics
confusionMatrix(tree_df$pred, tree_df$actual)

# (Optional) View prediction distribution for sanity check
table(tree_df$pred)
table(tree_df$actual)

cm_tree <- confusionMatrix(tree_df$pred, tree_df$actual)
tree_sens <- cm_tree$byClass["Sensitivity"]
tree_spec <- cm_tree$byClass["Specificity"]
tree_ppv <- cm_tree$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
tree_npv <- cm_tree$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
tree_acc <- cm_tree$overall["Accuracy"]

```

```{r Model Comparison}
# For each model, get the confusionMatrix object
cm_baseline <- confusionMatrix(factor(opt_preds), factor(adult_test$income))
cm_complex <- confusionMatrix(factor(complex_preds), factor(adult_test$income)) # replace complex_preds with your actual predictions for complex LR
cm_lda     <- confusionMatrix(factor(lda_pred_class), factor(adult_test$income)) # replace lda_pred_class as needed
cm_qda     <- confusionMatrix(results_df$pred, results_df$actual) # from your QDA chunk
cm_tree    <- confusionMatrix(tree_df$pred, tree_df$actual)       # from your tree chunk

# For each confusion matrix object, extract these metrics:
# Baseline LR
baseline_sens <- cm_baseline$byClass["Sensitivity"]
baseline_spec <- cm_baseline$byClass["Specificity"]
baseline_ppv  <- cm_baseline$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
baseline_npv  <- cm_baseline$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
baseline_acc  <- cm_baseline$overall["Accuracy"]

# Repeat for other models:
complex_sens <- cm_complex$byClass["Sensitivity"]
# ...etc for others

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Baseline LR", "Complex LR", "LDA", "QDA", "Tree"),
  Sensitivity = c(baseline_sens, complex_sens, lda_sens, qda_sens, tree_sens),
  Specificity = c(baseline_spec, complex_spec, lda_spec, qda_spec, tree_spec),
  AUROC = c(auc(roc_obj), auc(roc_complex), auc(roc_lda), auc(roc_qda), auc(roc_tree)),
  Threshold = c(optimal_threshold, complex_threshold, lda_threshold, qda_threshold, tree_threshold),
  PPV = c(baseline_ppv, complex_ppv, lda_ppv, qda_ppv, tree_ppv),
  NPV = c(baseline_npv, complex_npv, lda_npv, qda_npv, tree_npv),
  Accuracy = c(baseline_acc, complex_acc, lda_acc, qda_acc, tree_acc),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(comparison_table, caption = "Model Comparison Table")

plot(roc_obj, col = "red", main = "ROC Curves for All Models")  # Baseline
plot(roc_complex, col = "blue", add = TRUE)
plot(roc_lda, col = "green", add = TRUE)
plot(roc_qda, col = "purple", add = TRUE)
plot(roc_tree, col = "orange", add = TRUE)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("Baseline LR", "Complex LR", "LDA", "QDA", "Tree"),
       col = c("red", "blue", "green", "purple", "orange"), lwd = 2)

```
